notes.title: The Grey Dream Episode 7 - Status Update #7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44430369/4589dd205e0bae8ca0e05e97f00c448dade6352f.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Nothing much this week, mostly coding, writing and choosing music for the scenes. Like the last status, we've been mostly busy with the animations. Once again we found a problem with another animation and lost 2 days for it, but the rest turned out great. We've also started to spend a bit more time on Grey Dream instead of our new project to get this episode done sooner.

One last thing before we get to the scenes. If you have the game on Steam, please leave a review. It really helps us with the development of the game and with the morale.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497930/The_Grey_Dream/

[b]21. Scene[/b]: Finalised with 61 renders.

notes.title: Episode 5 - Status Update #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44430369/60a00a9374c3fed6b588e5bb9caf709d5e781845.png[/img]
Hello there,

We're back with another status update, but this one will be short.

We've finished rendering 11 more animations and will start working on the next ones next week. For the static renders, 200+ have been rendered since the last status update and are still rendering as we write this.

Lastly, we mentioned that we would be adding some additional language options with the upcoming update. As of last week, Italian translation was added to those options.

notes.title: Episode 5 - Status Update #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44430369/6c2d188629905fc478a1fc2fc2a059239bf37824.png[/img]
Hello there,

We're back with another status update. The last two weeks have been pretty smooth. We only had an issue with one asset. For some reason the asset couldn't see it's png file and gave us a headache for a few days. We eventually fixed it, but those 3 days were annoying.

Let's talk progress. We've finished another 300 renders of 5 scenes. On the coding side, 4 more scenes are coded and the fifth is on its way.

Anyway, as I was writing this, I realized that 4090 is making things so much faster and we need to share weekly status updates, so we might as well go to a weekly schedule with these updates.
